## Findings
- claim-1: Source-29 states that it resolves RWY Conjecture 4.10 and proves minimality of \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- claim-2: Source-29 describes the transposed generating set and says its minimality could be proved by transposing the arguments; this passage is not itself a theorem proving it. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-841]
## Strategy
Treat source-30 as RWY 2011, DOI `10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3`, supplied full-text SHA-256 `34367d52e8304bb02e179463391e5b0ef662a3f45aa2baea7b589247dd392128`. The bounded sweep consolidates repeated mentions of the same target.

| Source-30 target | Locator | Classification |
|---|---|---|
| Request for more efficient generators of \(I_w\) | [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 85-106] | Merely expository |
| Finding simple presentations in other root systems | [ibid., lines 100-106] | Still open |
| “Is it always possible to generate \(I_w\) by \(O(\mathrm{poly}(n))\) many generators?” | [ibid., lines 173-179] | Settled by source-29: negatively, via its exponential lower-bound family [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 248-252]. |
| Conjecture 4.10: minimality of the lower family (4.6), \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) | [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-946] | Settled by source-29 [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]. |
| Conjecture 4.10: minimality of the transposed family (4.5) | [ibid., lines 864-877; 938-946] | Still open relative to source-29: it only says the argument could be transposed [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-841]. |
| Unknown alternate use of GR02 techniques for general \(X_w\) | [ibid., lines 928-937] | Still open |
| Conjecture that \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\) requires \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) generators | [ibid., lines 956-975] | Still open |
| Stronger suspicion \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\) | [ibid., lines 967-975] | Still open |
| Whether concatenating minimal sets for the \(J_v\) gives a minimal set for \(I_w\) | [ibid., lines 976-994] | Merely expository: source-30 immediately gives counterexamples. |
| Question 5.1: find a minimal generating set for arbitrary type-\(A\) \(I_w\) | [ibid., lines 1143-1146] | Still open |
| Question 5.1 restricted to inclusion-defined/smooth and listed subclasses | [ibid., lines 1145-1161] | Still open; source-30 notes only a special Ding subclass is known. |

Repeated informal statements of Conjecture 4.10 occur at [ibid., lines 202-211; 564-574] and are covered by its two separated clauses above.

## Gaps
The requested source-30 extraction and source-29-relative classification is established. “Still open” means not settled by the supplied source-29 evidence, not a claim about all later literature.
